conventions.strip: u along the bolt (u=0 start, u=1 end, soft-faded ends), v=0.5 centre row
conventions.column: v along height: v=0 top (sky), v=1 bottom (impact), u=0.5 centre
conventions.crescent: pivot at bottom-centre (0.5,1.0); bright outer edge radius 0.94*h; +-72 deg
conventions.decal: top view: u = local +x, v = local +z (forward)
conventions.quarter: circle centre at texture corner (0,0); mirror uv for other quadrants

model_rules: flat cards (from==to on one axis), faces on both sides, shade false, uv 0..16 (per-face rotation 0/90/180/270, u1>u2 mirrors), single-axis element rotation 0/+-22.5/+-45, from/to within -16..32, layers >= 0.02 block apart
vanilla_rules: translucent item quads are sorted back-to-front by centroid distance and WRITE DEPTH: a card drawn earlier hides translucent cards behind it wherever its alpha >= 0.1; keep halos of overlay cards tight, prefer centred cards under centred overlays, split tall vertical cards so the low part sorts after the floor
magnified sampling is nearest-neighbour: >= ~32 texels per block for things seen up close
vertical faces may receive entity diffuse light 0.5..0.74 (up faces 1.0)
